title: Leandro finds the cave of tridactyl bodies

tellings.quote: I was walking along stage and tripped on the on the wall and then it fell apart and I could see this cave full of diatoms.

related.note: Same event, Leandro's discovery of the bodies, but this telling says his first version was an underground citadel or temple with stone sarcophagi, not a cave behind a collapsed wall.

plain: In 2015, in the Nazca region of Peru, a man known only as Leandro says he tripped against a wall while walking, the wall fell apart, and behind it he saw a cave full of strange three-fingered bodies. He tells it as the moment he found them himself, and the find matters because such bodies, if real, would not belong to any known creature. Elsewhere his account shifts, describing instead an underground citadel with stone coffins.
